title: sebaroDesign product facts file (facts.json)
description: One file per app or site. Normative prose, semantic rules and render requirements live in shared/FACTS-CONTRACT.md; tools/check_facts.py interprets THIS file directly with the keyword subset of tools/check_palette.py (PALETTE-CONTRACT section 11) and then runs the semantic rules and the optional verifiers.

schemaVersion.description: Contract version the file is written against. 1.3 (optional bilingual licence.label), 1.1 (optional check.limit) and 1.2 (optional place.jurisdiction, servers without a city, D90) are additive, so older files stay valid; a file that uses a newer field or rule should declare that version (warning SC3).

places.description: Every place data can be at: the user's device, destinations the user picks, servers run for the product, third parties. Paths may only end at a place listed here.

paths.description: Every movement of data between two places, including declared non-movements (trigger "never"). An app without any data movement has an empty list.

checks.description: The check list, in execution order. Every check has one of four states (D15); skipped and failed checks stay in the list.

id.description: kebab-case identifier, unique within its list.

langTag.description: BCP 47 language tag, restricted to language or language-REGION (de, en, de-AT).

text.description: Human-readable text shown by renderers: a plain string in meta.lang, or an object {"de": "…", "en": "…"} that must contain meta.lang (semantic rule LG1).

date.description: Calendar date YYYY-MM-DD (checked as a real date by the semantic rules).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (DE, FI, US). "EU" is not a country (rule PL4).

host.description: Lower-case host name, optionally with a leading "*." for every subdomain.

spdx.description: SPDX licence identifier or simple expression (AGPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-commercial).

dataCategory.description: Fixed vocabulary so every renderer labels data the same way (labels in FACTS-CONTRACT section 6).

policy.description: none = not stored (transit only); session = until the app/tab closes; days = see "days"; until-deleted = until the user deletes it or uninstalls; user-controlled = a place the user owns (exported file); processor-terms = the destination's own terms (note required).

proof.description: Per-field verification. "verified" requires at least one check, and every listed check must be in state passed (rules PR2, PR3). Renderers hide unverified reassurances (FACTS-CONTRACT section 8).

demo.description: true = reference/demo data, not a claim about a real product. Renderers show a visible demo marker; meta.notes must say what is invented (rule MD1).

version.description: The version these facts were verified for. Renderers compare it with the running version (staleness rule).

build.description: Optional build id (git short hash, versionCode). Compared like version when both sides know it.

label.description: Readable licence sentence in de and en (1.3); replaces the SPDX display, never its data or proof.

content.description: Optional licence of texts/media when it differs from the code (CC-BY-4.0).

reason.description: Required when open is false (rule PD2).

checkedOn.description: Date of the last full review of this file.

maxAgeDays.description: After checkedOn + maxAgeDays the file is stale (rule FR1, render rule R2).

analytics.description: Usage analytics of any kind, first- or third-party.

cookies.description: Cookies the product sets. Required for websites and web apps (rule PD1).

purpose.description: Required unless mode is none (rule AC1).

stores.description: Data at rest at this place that no declared path brings there (typically on-device storage).

kind.description: device = the user's own device/browser; user-destination = a place the user picks at the moment of the action (save dialog, share sheet); server = runs for the product (operator itself or a processor under contract); third-party = a service outside that contract.

operator.description: Legal name of who runs the place. Required for server and third-party (rule PL1).

city.description: Expected for server and third-party; needs country. From 1.2 (D90) a server may omit it when it names operator and country or jurisdiction (rules PL1, PL2).

country.description: Required for server and third-party unless (1.2) jurisdiction names the legal area and no city is given (rule PL1).

jurisdiction.description: 1.2 (D90): legal area the operator keeps the data in by contract, for a remote place without a city (e.g. a provider's EU jurisdiction). Satisfies PL1 together with operator; displayed as „Rechtsraum EU“ / "EU jurisdiction".

hosts.description: Host names that reach this place; the CSP and Tauri verifiers match against them.

proof.description: Required for remote places that a non-never path reaches (rule PL7).

trigger.description: never = a declared non-movement (rendered as a negative statement, e.g. "no backup to Google").

action.description: Label of the UI action that starts the path. Required for on-user-command (rule PA2); renderers attach the per-action hint to it.

transport.description: local = no network involved. Required unless trigger is never (rule PA3).

retention.description: How long the destination keeps what this path carries. Required unless trigger is never (rule PA3).

cloudPath.description: Id of the path to the Google backup place; its trigger says whether Auto Backup runs.

deviceTransfer.description: Device-to-device transfer to the user's next phone.

name.description: Package coordinate as the ecosystem writes it (io.sentry:sentry-android, @sentry/browser, sentry).

dataPath.description: The path this dependency sends data along (required for SDKs the blocklist marks declare-path).

items.description: Dependencies of note: storage, crypto, networking, crash reporting, push.

blocklistExceptions.description: Blocklist hits accepted with a reason; they stay visible as warnings (rule DP4).

ref.description: Where to find it. Demo files use the prefix "demo:" (rule MD2).

how.description: How: command, tool, or manual procedure.

verifier.description: The check_facts.py verifier that performs this check (enables rules CK7 and CI1).

reason.description: Required for skipped and failed (rules CK1, CK2).

evidence.description: Required for passed and failed (rule CK3).

date.description: When it ran (open: when it was registered).

version.description: Product version it ran against; must equal product.version (rule CK4).

limit.description: Optional (1.1): what this check does not cover. Notes show it as "Nicht geprüft: …" (FACTS-CONTRACT section 8.6); without it a check that names a verifier gets the verifier's built-in limit.
